sentences.en: Effective communication and mutual respect are essential elements of successful teamwork.
sentences.zh: 有效的沟通和相互尊重是成功团队合作的关键要素。

sentences.en: The most wonderful thing about baseball is teamwork.
sentences.zh: 棒球最令人赞叹的地方在于团队合作。

sentences.en: It is important to emphasize that the quality of our project depends on teamwork.
sentences.zh: 强调团队合作的质量对我们项目的成功至关重要。

senses.zh: —团队合作,团队合作精神;协力,配合
